With G(x)=1/(1/4+x^2), Volchkov compares the ordinate-weighted sum with the known real sum over reciprocal zeros; equality holds exactly under RH and termwise evaluation yields the weighted arg-zeta equality (16), identified with the b=1/2 specialization of Theorem 2a.
